params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Bel'Veth}} has no attack speed cap, but her {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}} does not grow by {{sti|xp|leveling up}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Empress's Decree:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Bel'Veth''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate - Inescapable:}} When '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, she generates a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Lavender''.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Lavender:}} For each stack, '''Bel'Veth''' gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth''' is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}}. Her {{as|attack speed}} does not increase through [[Champion statistic#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]].
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Empress's Decree:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' {{tip|ability}} casts grant her {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts.
params.description3:
{{sbc|Innate - Inescapable:}} Whenever '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|monster}}, or large {{tip|minion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she generates a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Lavender''. Large minions and monsters generate 1 stack, champions and epic monsters generate 2 stacks.

{{sbc|Lavender:}} For each stack, '''Bel'Veth''' gains {{as|{{pplevel|0.1; then +0.05*x for 4; then +0.1*x for 5; then +0.15*x|1 to 18|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}.
params.notes:
* '''Bel'Veth's''' ''attack speed cap'' is increased to {{fd|9999.0}}, however this value is already way beyond the technical limit for attack speed.
* ''Death in Lavender's'' {{tip|takedown}} effect will not trigger against monsters if they were slain by an enemy.

blurb.plain: Innate: Bel'Veth has no attack speed cap, but her attack speed does not grow by leveling up.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Empress's Decree: After casting an ability, Bel'Veth becomes ghosted and gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

blurb3.plain: Innate - Inescapable: When Bel'Veth scores a takedown against an enemy champion or large monster, she generates a permanent stack of Lavender.

blurb4.plain: Lavender: For each stack, Bel'Veth gains bonus attack speed.

description.plain: Innate: Bel'Veth is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap. Her attack speed does not increase through growth (per level).

description2.plain: Innate - Empress's Decree: Bel'Veth's ability casts grant her ghosting and 20% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts.

description3.plain:
Innate - Inescapable: Whenever Bel'Veth scores a takedown against a champion, large monster, or large minion within 3 seconds of damaging them, she generates a permanent stack of Lavender. Large minions and monsters generate 1 stack, champions and epic monsters generate 2 stacks. 
Lavender: For each stack, Bel'Veth gains ⟦pplevel⟧ bonus attack speed.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Bel'Veth}} {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through [[terrain]], dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through.
params.blurb2: ''Void Surge'' can be cast only within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown, each direction has a unique {{sti|cooldown}} that scales down with her {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.blurb4: ''Void Surge's'' damage against the first enemy hit can {{tip|critically strike}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} in the designated direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Against the first target, ''Void Surge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Bel'Veth|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
params.description3: ''Void Surge'' can be cast only within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown, and incurs a cooldown between casts. {{tt|Each cardinal direction|Total of 4 directions}} has a unique {{sti|cooldown}} that is reduced equivalent to {{fd|0.2}} {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}} per {{tt|{{as|1% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Benefits from all sources of bonus attack speed except the temporary bonus from Death in Lavender}}. These cooldowns reset upon [[death|respawning]].
params.description4: ''Void Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* ''Void Surge'' applies {{tip|basic damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|spell damage}} to the first (closest) enemy hit and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary enemies:
** ''Void Surge'' will apply {{tip|spell effects}} to all targets hit.
** {{tip|Spell vamp}} will grant {{tip|heal|healing}} from the damage dealt to all targets, but healing from damage to secondary targets is reduced to 33% effectiveness.
** {{as|{{sti|Life steal}}}} will heal based on the damage dealt to the first target hit.
* The icon partially darkens based on the combination of dashes available. When all dashes are expended, the cooldown indicates the next available dash.
* While in {{ai|Endless Banquet|Bel'Veth|True Form}}, ''Void Surge's'' dash distance is extended up to {{tt|225|Pending for test}} units when targeted across terrain.
* ''Void Surge'' can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}} only as the first enemy hit.

description4.plain: Void Surge resets Bel'Veth's basic attack timer.

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Bel'Veth}} enters a brief defensive stance, gaining {{sti|life steal}} and damage reduction.
During this time, '''Bel'Veth''' rapidly slashes at the most wounded enemy, with the max number of slashes increased based on {{as|her '''bonus''' attack speed}}. Each slash deals {{as|physical damage}}, and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|spell effects}} based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb2: ''Royal Maelstrom'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when '''Bel'Veth''' casts an ability.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' enters a frenzy for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which she is unable to move, but gains damage reduction and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
params.description2: While active, she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest {{as|'''current''' health}} percentage for up to 6 (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Benefits from all sources of bonus attack speed}}) times over the duration. Each slash deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, and applies {{tip|on-hit}}, {{tip|on-attack}}, and {{tip|spell effects|spell}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|12 to 24 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.12% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}} effectiveness. '''Bel'Veth''' cannot perform slashes while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
params.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per hit|{{ap|10 to 18}} {{as|(+ 12% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2 to 18*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2}}% AD)}}}}
params.description3: ''Royal Maelstrom'' deals 200% damage to {{tip|monsters}}, {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2 to 18*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2*2 to 18*2*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2*2}}% AD)}}}}
params.description4: ''Royal Maelstrom'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or when '''Bel'Veth''' casts an ability.
params.description6: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} and procs {{tip|basic damage}} required effects.
* ''Royal Maelstrom'' does not prioritize champions over other units.
* '''Bel'Veth''' cannot attack {{tip|structures}}, {{tip|wards}}, nor [[jungle plants]] with ''Royal Maelstrom''.
* If '''Bel'Veth''' is {{tip|berserk|berserked}} or {{tip|taunt|taunted}}, she will slash at the unit she is forced to attack.
* '''Bel'Veth''' will perform the slashes even if she is affected by {{tip|flee}}.{{bug}}
* Each slash's damage triggers a stack of {{ri|Conqueror}}.
* While ''Royal Maelstrom'' is active, the on-attack modifier also incorrectly applies to various other damaging effects triggered by the same damage instance, including {{ri|Hail of Blades}}{{tt|*|if previously activated by attacking}}, {{ri|Scorch}}, {{ii|Blackfire Torch}}, {{ii|Hextech Alternator}}, {{ii|Liandry's Torment}}, {{ii|Luden's Echo}}, {{ii|Scout's Slingshot}}.{{bug}}
** It does not, however, apply to other {{tip|spell effects}}.
* Despite this ability's cooldown starts on cast, it cannot be reduced by {{iis|Navori Flickerblade}} {{nie|Transcendence}} during the effect of this ability.{{bug|1}} Cooldowns of the other basic abilities can be normally reduced during this ability, though.
* ''Royal Maelstrom'' is special cased to end early if she is hit by {{cai|Q|Kassadin}}.
* ''Royal Maelstrom'' will not deal any damage if '''Bel'Veth''' has impossibily high attack speed values (such as her cap). This is intended to prevent server crashes and long lags.

blurb.plain:
Active: Bel'Veth enters a brief defensive stance, gaining life steal and damage reduction. 
During this time, Bel'Veth rapidly slashes at the most wounded enemy, with the max number of slashes increased based on her bonus attack speed. Each slash deals physical damage, and applies life steal, on-hit and spell effects based on the target's missing health.

blurb2.plain: Royal Maelstrom can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when Bel'Veth casts an ability.

description.plain: Active: Bel'Veth enters a frenzy for 1.5 seconds, during which she is unable to move, but gains damage reduction and life steal.

description2.plain: While active, she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest current health percentage for up to 6 (+ 1 per 40% bonus attack speed) times over the duration. Each slash deals physical damage, increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's missing health), and applies on-hit, on-attack, and spell effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to 12% – 24% (based on target's missing health) effectiveness. Bel'Veth cannot perform slashes while she is affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

description3.plain: Royal Maelstrom deals 200% damage to monsters, applies life steal, and is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description4.plain: Royal Maelstrom can be recast after 0.75 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or when Bel'Veth casts an ability.

description6.plain: The target does not have to be visible to be hit by this ability.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every attack {{tip|on-hit}} against the marked target deals {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} and generates a stack of ''Endless Banquet'' that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 8 stacks against epic {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus True Damage|{{ap|2 to 6}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Monster Damage|{{ap|2*8 to 6*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} When '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} while alive, a ''Void Coral'' is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, the pit {{ui|Rift Herald}}, and {{ui|Voidgrub|Voidgrubs}} (once per spawn group) spawn an ''Enhanced Void Coral''.
params.description3:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target ''Void Coral'' to consume it over the cast time, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by {{pp|type=seconds elapsed|key=%|25;42;69;96|0 to 0.75|changedisplay=true}} for the duration. She then creates an explosion at the location to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies within, capped at {{as|1500|true damage}} versus monsters, and assumes her {{sbc|True Form}} for {{pp|45;90;infinite|0;40;80|type=[[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|link=]] ''Lavender'' stacks}} seconds.
'''Bel'Veth''' consumes all existing ''Void Corals'' at once, generating a stack of ''{{ai|Death in Lavender|Bel'Veth|Lavender}}'' for each one consumed.
params.leveling3: {{st|True Damage|{{ap|150 to 250}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}} {{as|(+ 20% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
params.description4:
{{sbc|True Form:}} '''Bel'Veth''' evolves into a monster, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}}, increased size, as well as increased {{as|'''total''' attack speed}}. ''{{ai|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' can {{tip|dash}} through [[terrain]]. Consuming a ''Void Coral'' {{tt|refreshes|See notes}} the duration of {{sbc|True Form}} and {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Bel'Veth'''.

{{sbc|Enhanced Void Coral Bonus:}} {{sbc|True Form}} is empowered to causes ''Void Remora'' to spawn from allied and enemy {{tip|minions}} that die nearby.
params.description5: ''A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability. The passive {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} is affected by the {{tip|on-hit}} modifier of {{ai|Royal Maelstrom|Bel'Veth}}. See [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Pets]] for details about Void Remora and Void Corals.''
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|proc damage}} on the bonus true damage and deals {{tip|area damage}} on the explosion.
* ''Endless Banquet's'' {{tip|takedown}} effect will not trigger against monsters if they were slain by an enemy.
* ''Endless Banquet's'' true damage based on the target's missing health is calculated ''before'' the base damage is dealt.
* ''True Form's'' duration is displayed in '''Bel'Veth's''' resource bar, in seconds.
** The resource bar's color is white. It is purple when '''Bel'Veth''' has the enhanced ''Void Coral'' bonus.
* '''Bel'Veth's''' ''True Form'' at 80 {{ai|I|Bel'Veth|Lavender}} stacks will last indefinitely, but is still lost upon death.
* '''Bel'Veth''' will consume all existing ''Void Corals'' at once, therefore she is able to acquire the enhanced effects of ''True Form'' even if she does not physically consume an enhanced ''Void Coral''.
* The ''Void Coral'' that '''Bel'Veth''' consumes herself will not expire in the process of her doing so.
* '''Bel'Veth''' will consume all other ''Void Corals'' upon consumption regardless of range.
* Ranking up ''Endless Banquet'' will update the bonuses dynamically; if '''Bel'Veth''' has ''True Form'' upon the level-up, she will receive the upgraded stats.
* '''Bel'Veth''' gains the '''bonus''' health and heal from ''Endless Banquet'' at the start of the cast time.
* '''Bel'Veth''' will be able to consume the target ''Void Coral'' even if her dash is interrupted.
** She dashes at the start of the cast time.
* A ''Void Coral'' will '''not''' spawn when scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a summoned {{ui|Rift Herald}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Bel'Veth''' is in cast time:
** Movement summoner spells can be buffered to cast after the cast time completes if permitted.
** She is locked out of movement and attack actions for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the cast time completes and no buffering of them is permitted for the entirety of her lockout.

description.plain: Passive: Bel'Veth's basic attacks on-hit apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every attack on-hit against the marked target deals bonus true damage and generates a stack of Endless Banquet that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 8 stacks against epic monsters.

description2.plain: Passive: When Bel'Veth scores a takedown against an enemy champion or epic monster while alive, a Void Coral is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. Baron Nashor, the pit Rift Herald, and Voidgrubs (once per spawn group) spawn an Enhanced Void Coral.

description3.plain:
Active: Bel'Veth dashes to the target Void Coral to consume it over the cast time, slowing nearby enemies by 25% – 96% (based on seconds elapsed) for the duration. She then creates an explosion at the location to deal true damage to enemies within, capped at 1500 versus monsters, and assumes her True Form for ⟦pp⟧ seconds. 
Bel'Veth consumes all existing Void Corals at once, generating a stack of Lavender for each one consumed.

description4.plain:
True Form: Bel'Veth evolves into a monster, gaining bonus health, bonus attack range, increased size, as well as increased total attack speed. Void Surge can dash through terrain. Consuming a Void Coral refreshes the duration of True Form and heals Bel'Veth. 
Enhanced Void Coral Bonus: True Form is empowered to causes Void Remora to spawn from allied and enemy minions that die nearby.

description5.plain: A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability. The passive bonus true damage is affected by the on-hit modifier of Royal Maelstrom. See Pets for details about Void Remora and Void Corals.

blurb.plain: Passive: Bel'Veth's basic attacks deal bonus true damage and generates a stack that increases this damage against the same target. This effect can stack infinitely.

blurb2.plain: Passive: Takedowns against enemy champions and epic monsters spawn a Void Coral for some time. Taking down Baron Nashor, the pit Rift Herald, or a Voidgrub spawns an Enhance Void Coral.

blurb3.plain: Active: Bel'Veth dashes to the target Void Coral, gradually slowing nearby enemies before violently exploding, dealing true damage based on their missing health and assuming her True Form for a while. True Form's duration increases as Bel'Veth gains stacks of Lavender, eventually lasting until death.

blurb4.plain:
True Form: Bel'Veth gains bonus health, attack range, and increased total attack speed. During this time, Void Surge can dash through terrain. Consuming more Void Corals renews the form's duration and heals her instead. 
Enhanced Void Coral Bonus: True Form is empowered to cause Void Remora to spawn from minions that die nearby.
